title: Kantor slide deck
description: A presentation for `kantor slides build deck.json -o deck.pptx`. The same elements go to the MCP slides tools.

size.description: Slide size: 16:9 (default, 13.333 × 7.5 in), 4:3, 16:10, a4, letter, or {w, h}.

units.description: What bare numbers in lengths mean (default emu). Strings such as "1in" always say their unit.

text.description: Default text formatting of every element (colours may be palette names, the font heading or body).

font.description: Typeface, e.g. "Inter" (default: the theme's body font).

caps.description: All capitals (the text is written in capitals).

background.description: Every slide's background unless the slide has its own.

preset.description: A built-in look: editorial (warm paper, Instrument Serif titles and numbers, hairline rules, no boxes), swiss (white, Inter bold titles under a thick rule, mono labels, solid square panels, one strong blue) or mono (swiss in black, white and one red). Sets the theme colours and fonts, palette, text styles, card style, header, footer, covers and the slide background; the deck's own settings go over it (its theme accent recolours the preset's tints).

card_style.description: How cards, stats, comparisons, callouts and clean tables are drawn: rule (no boxes, a rule on top, numbers in the heading font) or fill (square panels, the highlighted one in the accent colour). Default from the preset; fill without one.

palette.description: Named colours used by styles and components (and allowed wherever a colour is): #RRGGBB or a theme colour. Default from the theme: accent / primary accent1, highlight accent2, ink tx1, dark tx2, panel / paper bg2, background / white / on_accent / on_dark bg1, muted, line / divider, bar, accent_soft / tint, on_dark_accent mixed from them; good / success, bad / danger fixed.

styles.description: Named text styles (used with `style`): eyebrow, page_number, title, subtitle, body, small, note, label, card_title, stat, number, numeral, badge, callout, table, table_header, footer, cover_brand, cover_eyebrow, cover_title, cover_subtitle, cover_meta, cover_mark, cover_mark_label, section_eyebrow, section_title, section_subtitle, and any of your own. Keys given here go over the preset's.

header.description: Where a slide's eyebrow, title and subtitle go (a preset turns it on; false: none). Slides with a header put `title` in a title placeholder, and components default to the area under it.

content_gap.description: Space between the header and the content area.

rule.description: A rule above the eyebrow, or beside it (position left): {color, w (a length or "full"), h, position, gap}, or false.

gap.description: Space under a rule above the eyebrow.

page_number.description: The page number (02) before the eyebrow.

separator.description: Between the page number and the eyebrow (default " / ").

text.description: Text at the right of the eyebrow row; true: the footer's text (then not in the footer).

footer.description: Each slide's footer (cover and section slides have none unless `footer: true`).

page_numbers.description: A slide number field (02) at the right (default true).

logo.description: A PNG or JPEG at the left.

bar.description: A bar along the bottom edge: {color, height}, or false.

rule.description: A hairline across the content width above the footer: {color, width}, or false.

mark.description: A small square at the bottom right: {color, size}, or false.

y.description: Top of the cover's text (default: centred).

rule.description: A rule above the eyebrow, or beside it (position left): {color, w (a length or "full"), h, position, gap}, or false.

gap.description: Space under a rule above the eyebrow.

logo.description: A picture at the top left.

motif.description: block: an accent block down the right carrying the slide's `mark`; grid: a 4×4 grid of squares.

brand.description: The footer's text at the top left (when there is no logo).

section_y.description: Top of a section slide's text (default: centred).

content.description: The content area under the header (default 0.75in margins, from 2.2in to 0.85in above the bottom) and the gap between cards.

transition.description: Every slide's transition unless it has its own.

length.description: A length: a number in `units` (default emu: 914400 per inch, 12700 per point, 360000 per cm) or a string with a unit: "1.5in", "2.5cm", "40mm", "18pt", "120px", "914400emu".

fraction.description: 0 to 1, or a percentage such as "25%".

color.description: #RRGGBB (also #RGB, or #RRGGBBAA with opacity), a theme colour (accent1-accent6, tx1, tx2, bg1, bg2, dk1, lt1, dk2, lt2, hlink, folHlink), or {color, opacity}.

angle.description: Degrees: 0 left to right, 90 top to bottom (default).

arrow.description: An arrowhead: a type, or {type, width, length} (small, medium, large).

line.description: An outline: "none", a colour, or {color, width, dash, head, tail, cap}. Shapes without one get the theme's (accent 1, darker).

text.description: A new line is a line break in the paragraph.

field.description: A field PowerPoint keeps up to date (text optional).

font.description: Typeface, e.g. "Inter" (default: the theme's body font).

caps.description: All capitals (the text is written in capitals).

style.description: A text style of the deck (eyebrow, title, subtitle, body, small, label, card_title, stat, ...); keys given beside it win.

bullet.description: true (•), false/"none", "number" (1. 2. 3.), one character such as "–", or a numbering scheme such as "alphaLcParenR".

line_spacing.description: A multiple of single spacing (1.2) or points ("20pt").

caps.description: All capitals (the text is written in capitals).

style.description: A text style of the deck (eyebrow, title, subtitle, body, small, label, card_title, stat, ...); keys given beside it win.

text.description: A string (a new line starts a paragraph), or paragraphs: strings or {text | runs, align, bullet, level, line_spacing, space_before, space_after, font, size, bold, italic, underline, strike, color}.

shape.description: A shape: geometry, fill, outline and text. Default look as PowerPoint's: accent 1 fill, darker outline, white centred text.

name.description: The shape's name (shown in the selection pane).

geometry.description: A DrawingML preset shape: rect (default), roundRect, ellipse (or oval), triangle, diamond, chevron, homePlate (arrow pentagon), pentagon, hexagon, rightArrow, leftArrow, star5, flowChartProcess, ... (all 187 ECMA-376 presets).

radius.description: Corner radius of a rounded rectangle (sets geometry roundRect when no geometry is given).

adjust.description: The preset's adjust values as written in the file, e.g. {"adj": 25000} (chevron point depth, 1/1000 % of the shorter side).

anchor.description: Vertical position of the text (shapes: middle, text boxes: top).

insets.description: Space between the edge and the text: one length or [left, top, right, bottom] (default 0.1in left/right, 0.05in top/bottom).

autofit.description: none: text may overflow (default); shrink: PowerPoint shrinks text that overflows; resize: the shape grows to fit.

wrap.description: Wrap lines at the shape's width (default true).

vertical.description: Text direction: turned to read downwards or upwards.

line_element.description: A straight line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2), optionally with arrowheads.

picture.description: A picture from a PNG or JPEG file, optionally cropped and cut to a shape.

name.description: The picture's name (shown in the selection pane).

geometry.description: A DrawingML preset shape: rect (default), roundRect, ellipse (or oval), triangle, diamond, chevron, homePlate (arrow pentagon), pentagon, hexagon, rightArrow, leftArrow, star5, flowChartProcess, ... (all 187 ECMA-376 presets).

adjust.description: The preset's adjust values as written in the file, e.g. {"adj": 25000} (chevron point depth, 1/1000 % of the shorter side).

path.description: A PNG or JPEG file: absolute (~ allowed) or, in a deck file, relative to it.

crop.description: Fractions (0.1) or percentages ("10%") cut off each side.

fit.description: With both w and h: stretch to the box (default), fit inside it keeping the aspect (contain), or fill it and crop the rest (cover). With one of w/h the other follows the picture's aspect; with neither, its size at 96 dpi.

w.description: Table width: columns are scaled to it.

h.description: Table height when no row heights are given (split evenly).

columns.description: Column widths, or a number of equal columns (needs w). Default: as many as the first row's cells, splitting w.

rows.description: Rows of cells: text, numbers, cell objects, or null for a cell covered by a span.

header.description: The first row is a header: bold, header_color on header_fill (default true).

banded.description: Every other body row gets band_fill (default false).

border.description: Every cell's borders (default 1 pt #BFBFBF; "none" for none).

cell_margins.description: One length or [left, top, right, bottom].

style_id.description: A PowerPoint table style GUID, e.g. {5C22544A-7EE6-4342-B048-85BDC9FD1C3A}.

font.description: Typeface, e.g. "Inter" (default: the theme's body font).

caps.description: All capitals (the text is written in capitals).

style.description: A text style of the deck (eyebrow, title, subtitle, body, small, label, card_title, stat, ...); keys given beside it win.

preset.description: clean: a rounded header bar, soft banded rows, no grid lines, colours from the palette; x, y, w default to the content area.

first_bold.description: With preset clean: the first column bold (default true).

element.description: Something on a slide, by `type`: an element, or a component that expands into several.

background.description: A colour, a gradient, {"picture": path}, or "inherit" (the layout's).

layout.description: Title Slide, Title and Content, Title Only or Blank (name or number). Default: Title and Content with bullets, Title Only with a title, else Blank.

elements.description: Drawn in order: later ones on top.

kind.description: cover: a big title with the cover's motif; section: a dark slide with a big title, components under it (see the deck's `cover`).

eyebrow.description: The small label above the title (needs a header or preset).

footer.description: false hides the deck's footer on this slide.

footer_note.description: Text in the footer, e.g. a source.

meta.description: A cover's small line at the bottom, e.g. who presents.

mark.description: A cover's big number in the accent block (cover motif block).

mark_label.description: A small line at the top of the accent block.

icon.description: A Lucide icon (https://lucide.dev/icons) as an editable outline shape: recolour it like a line.
The icon's name, e.g. shield-check, rocket, chart-line, users.

size.description: Width and height (or give w / h).

stroke.description: Line width (default a twelfth of the size, as Lucide's).

chart.description: A real, editable chart (PowerPoint's Edit Data opens its data): column, bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter or combo.

name.description: The chart's name (shown in the selection pane).

chart.description: Chart type. combo: columns with lines/areas (series `type`, `axis`).

stacked.description: Column, bar, line, area: stack the series (true / "stacked") or stack to 100% ("percent").

categories.description: Labels along the category axis (scatter: the x values, numbers).

values.description: One per category; null leaves a gap.

colors.description: Bars or slices of their own colour, one per category (null: the series colour).

type.description: Combo (or column/line/area chart): this series' type (combo default: first column, others line).

line.description: A line series' line: width, dash, colour.

data_labels.description: Data labels: true (values; pie/doughnut: percentages), false, or {show: value|percent|category|series or a list, position: center|inside_end|inside_base|outside_end|left|right|above|below|best_fit, format (e.g. "0.0%"), size, bold, italic, color (#RRGGBB)}.

legend.description: Default: bottom with several series or a pie, else none.

data_labels.description: Data labels: true (values; pie/doughnut: percentages), false, or {show: value|percent|category|series or a list, position: center|inside_end|inside_base|outside_end|left|right|above|below|best_fit, format (e.g. "0.0%"), size, bold, italic, color (#RRGGBB)}.

number_format.description: Excel number format of the values (labels and value axis), written as Excel stores it: "#,##0.0", "0%", "\"Rp\" #,##0". `,` is the thousands and `.` the decimal separator in the code; PowerPoint and Excel show them in the viewer's locale (Indonesian: 1.234,5).

axis.description: The value axis (horizontal in a bar chart).

number_format.description: Tick label format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0%" (default: the values' number_format).

reverse.description: Values (categories) in reverse order. A bar chart's categories reversed (first at the top) keep the value axis at the bottom.

visible.description: false hides the axis (line, ticks and labels); default true.

category_axis.description: The category axis: title, reverse, visible (scatter: the x axis, with min/max/major_unit).

number_format.description: Tick label format, e.g. "#,##0" or "0%" (default: the values' number_format).

reverse.description: Values (categories) in reverse order. A bar chart's categories reversed (first at the top) keep the value axis at the bottom.

visible.description: false hides the axis (line, ticks and labels); default true.

gap_width.description: Column/bar: gap between categories, % of a bar (default 150).

overlap.description: Column/bar: overlap of a category's bars in % (stacked: 100).

font.description: The chart's text (default: the deck's typeface and colour).

colors.description: A one-series column, bar, pie or doughnut chart: each bar's or slice's colour (null: automatic), e.g. to highlight bars below target.

target_line.description: A dashed horizontal line at a value (column, line, area, combo): a number or {value, label (default Target), color, width, dash}. It is a line series, so it shows in the legend and in Edit Data.

stat_cards.description: A row of stats (big value, label, detail) spread across the box: under a rule (rule card style) or on square panels (fill); one may be highlighted.

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

highlight.description: Stands out: an accent rule (rule card style) or an accent fill (fill card style).

cards.description: A grid of cards: number or icon, heading, text or bullets; under a rule (rule card style) or on square panels (fill). Short cards put the number beside the text.

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

icon.description: A Lucide icon name (instead of the number).

numbered.description: A number on each card (default true; an item's icon replaces it).

fill.description: The cards' fill in the fill card style (default the palette's panel).

highlight.description: This card (from 1) stands out: an accent rule or an accent fill.

steps.description: Numbered steps down the box: big numerals with hairlines between (rule card style) or square number badges (fill).

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

icon.description: A Lucide icon name (instead of the number).

timeline.description: Phases across the box: square markers on a line (done ink, current accent, later outlined) or chevrons, with a label, title and text under each.

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

style.description: Square markers on a line (default) or chevrons.

callout.description: The one sentence to remember, with a lead-in: a pull quote beside an accent rule (rule card style) or a solid bar (fill); by default across the bottom of the content area.

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

numbered_list.description: Rows of a number and text, centred on each other.

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

icon.description: A Lucide icon name (instead of the number).

marker.description: badge (default): a numeral (rule card style) or a square badge (fill); number: a big 01, 02.

boxed.description: A hairline above each row (rule card style) or a panel behind it (fill); default true.

comparison.description: Two to four columns side by side (before/after, options), each with a tag, title and bullets.

gap.description: Space between cards (default the deck's content gap, 0.24in).

badge.description: A square badge with a number, short text or icon.

geometry.description: A preset shape (default rect; ellipse for a circle).

text_style.description: A named text style: character and paragraph formatting. `font` may be heading or body (the theme's fonts), `color` a palette name.

transition.description: How the slide comes in: a type, "none", or {type, duration (seconds or "700ms"), direction (left, right, up, down: the way slides move; in, out for split and zoom), orientation (horizontal, vertical: split), through_black (fade, cut), advance_after (seconds)}.
